queries_run: DexCom market share gaining OR losing 2026 Abbott Libre CGM
DexCom new entrant threat CGM 2026 Medtronic MiniMed Simplera Roche Sequel

findings.claim: 10-K 點名 Abbott、MiniMed（Guardian Connect、Simplera）、Roche 等為直接對手；Stelo 的直接對手為 Abbott；並提到主要在中國的新興競爭者。
findings.excerpt: In selling Stelo, we compete directly with the Diabetes Care division of Abbott Laboratories. Collectively with us, these companies currently account for the majority of the worldwide sales of self-monitored glucose testing systems. We are also aware of emerging competitors primarily located in China.

findings.claim: 10-K：非傳統醫材業者（大型上市公司）正開發競品，且 FDA 2026-01-06 的一般健康器材指引可能使其受惠。
findings.excerpt: We are also aware of companies outside the traditional medical device sector that are attempting to develop competitive products and services, including for the general health and wellness, or population health space.

findings.claim: CMS 將 CGM 納入 DMEPOS 競標（2027 簽約、2028-01-01 起付款變更），預期約 10 份 CGM 合約，得標價取第 75 百分位，預期降低 Medicare 給付。
findings.excerpt: CMS anticipates that ten (10) contracts will be awarded for CGMs.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 聚合站摘要稱 Abbott 2025 CGM 營收份額約 52.8%、DexCom 約 33.9%（Mordor 引述，二手），Q1 2026 DexCom 成長 15% vs Abbott CGM 7.5%；未讀到原頁，列為 clues。

clues.claim: Q1 2026 DexCom 營收年增約 15%（美國 +11%、國際 +19%），Zacks 連結到份額增加；Abbott Libre Duo 擴張為競爭風險。
clues.source: Zacks: DXCM stock up nearly 35% YTD

clues.claim: Mordor 引述：2025 CGM 營收份額 Abbott 52.83%、DexCom 33.89%、Medtronic 10.10%。
